breakdown.description: For curved flow, pressure is higher on the outside of the turn to provide the required centripetal force; stating pressure increases toward the center reverses the correct direction of the pressure gradient.
breakdown.reason: The generated specification repeats the incorrect statement 'Apply the condition that pressure increases toward the center of curvature' verbatim from the incomplete prompt. The ground truth correctly indicates that pressure increases outward (away from the center of curvature), as required by the normal momentum balance dP/dn = ρV²/R with n directed outward. The agent failed to fix this error.
